description: The same workflow_request_id is POSTed a second time after already being processed.
prerequisite: valid_log_only.json's request must have been sent at least once first.
observed_result: Verified with a different id pair (test-log-only-004 sent twice): second call returned 409, status=DUPLICATE, error.code=DUPLICATE_REQUEST, and the mock /route server was not called a second time.
